about: Library-kind package (.code-docs.json declares the root). LEN-02 visibility tier: a public item may run to 15 lines, a non-public one to 10, an unplaced one (a module doc) gets the library tier. Public: Rust pub, enum variants and trait items of a pub parent, pub fields; Python names with no leading underscore under public classes and outside functions, dunders included, multi-line signatures included; TS exports and members of an exported class; Go capitalised identifiers, methods included. Non-public: Rust fn, pub(crate), private-enum variants and private fields; Python _names, methods of a _class and nested functions; an unexported TS function and a private member; a lowercase Go func. A Rust //! module doc directly above a /// item doc stays a separate block.
